source_policy: Weiser printed text is only a historical locator; each independent witness is bounded to the exact factual claim.
No journalistic or modern rite automatically proves a 1962 priestly formula or obligation.
Partial witnesses are registered but not promoted to finished app summaries.
All items map to previously unmapped P1 observations, without changing the frozen wave02 ledger.
No mass reader, calendar or app content automatically changed.

witnesses.title: Family Advent wreath
witnesses.issuer: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops
witnesses.verified_scope: Modern Catholic household wreath and family prayer in Advent, optional; original Protestant historical origin is not independently verified here.

witnesses.title: Family prayer at a Christmas crib
witnesses.issuer: Holy See — Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy, n. 109
witnesses.verified_scope: Family Christmas Eve Nativity-crib prayers including Luke's account and carols, not a required 1962 pre-Mass ceremony.

witnesses.title: Irish Christmas household and window candles
witnesses.issuer: National Museum of Ireland — Christmas in years gone by; National Folklore Collection UCD
witnesses.verified_scope: Irish household candles remembering the departed; local folk archive separately documents Christmas Eve window candle for hospitality. Folklore of guaranteed blessings/returning spirits is not promoted.

witnesses.title: Epiphany announcement of Easter
witnesses.issuer: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops
witnesses.verified_scope: Custom of solemnly announcing movable feasts on Epiphany, linked to Easter's centrality; source gives contemporary text, not certified 1962 use.

witnesses.title: Regional Palm Sunday branches
witnesses.issuer: Église catholique en France — Semaine Sainte et Pâques
witnesses.verified_scope: French Catholic use of buis, olive, laurel or palm according to region, blessed by priest and brought home; no magical protection.

witnesses.title: Palm fronds made into devotional crosses
witnesses.issuer: Catholic Culture — Blessed Palms in the Home
witnesses.verified_scope: Modern Catholic household devotional practice making crosses from blessed Palm Sunday fronds; historical exact weaving and Weiser's geographic scope remain unverified.

witnesses.title: Colombian Holy Week entombment processions
witnesses.issuer: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage — Popayán Holy Week processions
witnesses.verified_scope: Longstanding local Holy Week processions in Popayán, Colombia, including Laying in the Tomb. No evidence of identical celebration in every Spanish or Latin American church.

witnesses.title: Andalusian Holy Week confraternities and hooded penitents
witnesses.issuer: Turismo de Andalucía — Términos de Semana Santa
witnesses.verified_scope: Local Andalusian Semana Santa brotherhoods with nazareno, tunic and capirote; this is a public confraternity tradition, not a Roman Mass rubric.

witnesses.title: Easter egg as Christian symbol of life
witnesses.issuer: Holy See — Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy, n. 150
witnesses.verified_scope: Easter eggs symbolize life in Christian popular piety; the Vatican documents egg blessings. Specific imagery of the tomb and historical 1962 Roman Ritual text not authenticated.

witnesses.title: Veni Creator at Pentecost
witnesses.issuer: Holy See — John Paul II, First Vespers of Pentecost, 29 May 2004
witnesses.verified_scope: The hymn Veni Creator Spiritus is directly attested for Pentecost prayer; this source does not establish all Weiser-described councils and retreats usages.

witnesses.title: Corpus Christi route-side household windows
witnesses.issuer: Holy See — Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy, n. 162
witnesses.verified_scope: Decorating streets and windows with flowers accompanying Eucharistic processions. It does not independently verify Weiser's exact candles-and-images detail.

witnesses.title: Maltese Resurrection procession with running statue
witnesses.issuer: Archdiocese of Malta — Holy Week processions in Malta and Gozo
witnesses.verified_scope: Easter Sunday local processions with image of the Risen Christ are independently attested; this notice does not establish their exact running choreography.

witnesses.title: Rogation fields sprinkled by priest
witnesses.issuer: Église catholique en France — Le retour des rogations
witnesses.verified_scope: Documented local priestly agricultural-equipment, livestock and seed blessing; NOT a witness to the exact priestly sprinkling of fields in the Weiser row.

witnesses.title: Shrove Tuesday confession immediately before Ash Wednesday
witnesses.issuer: USCCB — Promoting Participation in the Sacrament of Penance
witnesses.verified_scope: Confession as Lenten preparation documented, but no independent Shrove Tuesday date-specific practice or mandate.

witnesses.title: Irish Christmas candle adopted in America
witnesses.issuer: National Folklore Collection UCD — Festival Customs, Co. Cork
witnesses.verified_scope: Irish Christmas candle use is independently attested in County Cork; migration or historical adoption of the custom in America is not proved.

witnesses.title: Historical Roman Ritual Easter egg blessing
witnesses.issuer: Holy See — Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy, n. 150
witnesses.verified_scope: Church acknowledges egg blessing as popular piety, but does not certify the text, edition, minister or 1962 availability of the Roman Ritual rite.
